script.text: Dataset We used a set of three classic garden path constructions from large-scale syntactic ambiguity processing benchmark, consisting of self-paced reading time data from 2000 participants (Huang et al., 2023).
The constructions include: Main verb/ reduced relative clause garden path (MV/RR), Direct object/ sentential complement garden path (NP/S), Transitive/ intransitive garden path (NP/Z) (see Table 2).
There are 24 lexically matched item sets for each construction.
Each set has an experimental sentence with a tempory syntactic ambiguity and an unambiguous control sentence.

script.text: Figure 6 compares the three constructions in four bar charts.
In panel a, the Human Effect Size chart shows the largest effect for NP/Z.
In panel b, the Simulated Effect Size chart follows the same order.
